calvin.title: Melvin Calvin, University of California — Photosynthesis
calvin.context: Figures 11–12 and lines 445–456: CO2 plus ribulose diphosphate yields two 3-PGA molecules.

hatch.title: Hatch and Slack — Photosynthesis by sugar-cane leaves
hatch.context: Initial 14CO2 labeling of C4 dicarboxylic acids in sugarcane followed by phosphoglycerate.

myco.title: Integrated Metabolomics, Transcriptomics and Ultrastructural Assessment of Monotropa uniflora
myco.context: Introduces fully mycoheterotrophic achlorophyllous plant; obtains carbon by association with fungi.

acid.title: Winter & Smith — CAM photosynthesis: the acid test
acid.context: PDF pp. 600–601 and original Table 1 compare dawn and dusk acidity; daytime malate decarboxylation supplies CO₂ for Rubisco.

photo.title: Levey et al. — Photorespiration in the C₄ plant Flaveria bidentis
photo.context: Abstract and Introduction: 2PG is the product of Rubisco oxygenation and photorespiration recycles it; typically low rates in C₄.

light.title: OpenStax Biology 2e — The Light-Dependent Reactions of Photosynthesis
light.context: Fig. 8.17 and text: PSII extracts electrons from water and releases oxygen; chloroplast ATP synthesis uses the proton gradient.

oxid.title: OpenStax Biology 2e — Oxidative Phosphorylation
oxid.context: Electron transport chain: oxygen is final electron acceptor in mitochondrial respiration.

winter.title: Winfield et al. — Cold- and light-induced changes in the transcriptome of wheat
winter.context: Background, lines 115–117; winter varieties require extended cold for competence. Results lines 150 and 198–200 and Additional file 2: unvernalized Harnesk and Solstice did not flower.

night.title: Sumitomo et al. — Spectral sensitivity of flowering in response to a night break treatment
night.context: Abstract lines 93–96: short light exposure near the middle of the night inhibits flowering of short-day chrysanthemum; yellow through red strongly inhibitory.

bean.title: Soltani et al. — The genetics and physiology of seed dormancy in common bean
bean.context: Seed germination and imbibition, Fig. 1: scarifying seed coat increased germination and water uptake in a hard-seeded bean line; 25% vs 100% at 48 h.

tomato.title: University of Arizona Cooperative Extension — Growing Tomatoes
tomato.context: Variety selection: determinate tomatoes more compact and fruit ripens close together; plant successive crops to extend harvest.

tomatoProcess.title: NC State Extension — Tomatoes for Processing in Eastern North Carolina
tomatoProcess.context: Modern processing varieties are bred for concentrated fruit set, permitting once-over mechanical harvest.

water.title: USDA NRCS — Soil Quality Indicators: Available Water Capacity
water.context: p.1 field capacity, wilting point and available water; Fig. 1 texture; p.2 salts and management.

survey.title: USDA NRCS — Soil Survey Laboratory Information Manual
survey.context: pp.69–70 permanent wilting: indicator plants do not recover in a humid chamber; laboratory approximation −1500 kPa and species-related variation.

density.title: USDA NRCS — Soil Health: Bulk Density
density.context: Soil bulk density in g/cm³, dry mass divided by soil core volume; heavy equipment and compaction.

cec.title: USDA NRCS — Soil Tech Note 15A: Cation Exchange Capacity
cec.context: Negatively charged sites on clay and stable organic matter hold nutrient cations; nitrate behaves differently; CEC depends on texture and organic matter.

exchange.title: USDA NRCS — Part 652 Irrigation Guide, Chapter 2: Soils
exchange.context: Chapter 2, Soil reaction, CEC and salinity; CEC is amount of cations held which may be exchanged with another cation in solution.

tomatoGene.title: Pnueli et al. — The SELF-PRUNING gene of tomato
tomatoGene.context: Abstract: shortening sympodial segments and shoot termination after two consecutive inflorescences in determinate tomato.

cecMethod.title: USDA NRCS — Kellogg Soil Survey Laboratory Methods Manual, Method 4B1a1a2a1
cecMethod.context: p.342, Introduction and Principle: ammonium saturation, removal of excess ammonium and displacement with potassium chloride followed by measurement.
